resources.string: Add a PDF from your phone. Audora remembers where it is; the file is not copied.
Audora could not load your library. Please share the logs from Settings.
File moved or deleted. Tap to find it.
Audora can no longer open this file. Tap to pick it again.
The PDF stays on your phone. You can add it again later.
The app you picked from only lends the file for a moment. Save the PDF to your phone first, then add it from there.
Audora could not read that file. It may have been moved or deleted.
That file is not a PDF.
That is a different PDF. Pick the same file, or remove this book and add the new one.
That book is no longer in your library.
Audora could not save your library. Is your phone\'s storage full?
Reading aloud arrives in a later update. For now this shows what Audora found in the first pages.
This book is no longer in your library.
%1$d pages. Read the first %2$d in %3$d ms.
%1$d sentences, %2$d rebuilt word spans, %3$d unmapped characters.
No text on these pages (scanned pages are read with OCR in Phase 3).
This file is damaged or is not a PDF Audora can open.
Audora could not read this file. It may have been moved or deleted.
The PDF engine failed to start. Please share the logs.
A page could not be read. Please share the logs.
Send Audora\'s log to whoever is helping you. It never contains text from your PDFs.
Could not prepare the logs. Please try again.
Audora logs attached. What happened, and roughly when?
Audora stopped while reading page %1$d. Resume where it stopped?
Marks a book as playing without sound. Then force-stop Audora in App info and reopen it: the resume prompt should appear and the log should name the stop.
Marked as reading. Now force-stop Audora and reopen it.
